messages:
incidents-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts for /v1/generate in us-west1. Alert rule: 5xx_rate > 2% for 3m. Paging alice (oncall).

alice (oncall): Ack — looking. starting with logs and rate-limit dashboard.

ben (sre): I see a sharp spike in 429s from the global rate-limiter ~9:12 UTC, then downstream gateway overload and 502/504s. Possible quota misapply on the shard?

carla (eng-runtime): Confirming — recent deploy at 09:05 that rolled out a new global quota policy that aggregated tenant bursts into a single global bucket. Logs show token_bucket.rejected++ around 09:11.

dave (support): Any customer-facing impact? Support queue jumped, a few customer complaints referencing timeouts at ~09:13.

evan (product): Noted — customer impact estimate? Which tiers affected?

alice (oncall): Quick numbers from analytics: for the last 10m error-rate for generation endpoints in us-west1 = 4.8%. Affected requests mostly from medium/large tenants behind the new global quota. Some small tenants unaffected.

ben (sre): Hypothesis: quota change caused early 429s; some clients retry quickly and overwhelm gateway causing 5xx cascade. Steps: 1) rollback quota config 2) increase gateway worker pool 3) enable fallback routing to older model variant for affected tenants.

carla (eng-runtime): I can revert the quota config. Patch to revert is ready. Applying now to prod config store (etcd). Command: 

```
# revert global-quota -> per-tenant policy
kubectl exec -n control-plane config-roller -- /bin/roller apply --file /configs/quota/revert-global-2026-03-15.yaml
```

paging-bot: alice (oncall) is now the active pager.

alice (oncall): rolling revert now. Pushing patch...

carla (eng-runtime): Revert applied at 09:18 UTC. Confirming config version rolled back.

ben (sre): I'm scaling gateway pods by +30% to absorb spike. Running: 

```
kubectl scale deployment gateway-us-west1 -n infra --replicas=13
```

ben (sre): Increasing worker threads on active gateways too.

alice (oncall): Observability check — 5xx trending down from 4.8% -> 2.2% in last 4m. 429s dropped sharply after revert.

dave (support): Posting to status page: brief outage affecting generation endpoints in us-west1; degraded performance 09:10–09:20 UTC. Drafting note and notify affected customers. :loud_sound:

carla (eng-runtime): One sticky thing: some cache entries for upstream token-buckets were saturated. I'm flushing the control-plane cache to ensure new policy takes effect: 

```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/flush-cache?scope=quota
```

ben (sre): After cache flush and scaling, error rates down to 0.6% now. Latency back near normal.

alice (oncall): Good. Initiating short-term mitigations: 1) rollback was completed, 2) gateway scaled, 3) emergency rate-limit exception for top-affected tenants for 30m.

carla (eng-runtime): Applied per-tenant override: `rate_limit.override[tenant_id] = burst:500` for the 6 tenants that were impacted.

evan (product): We should notify the account execs for those tenants. I'll send a note and coordinate with support. Draft: "We experienced transient rate limiting issue due to a global quota configuration; we've reverted and applied mitigations. No data loss; requests briefly erroring/retried."

dave (support): On it. Pushing proactive emails and adding context to support tickets.

ben (sre): Quick root-cause notes: config change introduced global aggregation of burst tokens. That meant tenant-specific bursts were consumed by peers under heavy load, causing early 429s. Retry storms then overloaded gateways -> 5xx.

alice (oncall): Action items (short):
- carla: initiate postmortem with timeline and config diff (owner)
- ben: restore any autoscaler limits altered and check HPA metrics for gateways
- evan/dave: customer comms and incident severity classification
- alice: keep monitoring and sync if errors >1% in next 30m

carla (eng-runtime): Creating postmortem doc now. Will include the Yaml diff and the rollout pipeline check that missed the canary.

paging-bot: Incident acknowledged by on-call at 09:16 UTC.

alice (oncall): final check — last 10m error-rate us-west1 = 0.4%, no ongoing retries backlog. Marking as mitigated. Will keep thread open for postmortem notes.

ben (sre): Recommend a short policy: require a canary for global quota-affecting changes for 15m+ with throttled traffic. I'll add to runbook.

evan (product): Agreed. Also product will add a policy review step for quota changes that affect multiple tenants.

dave (support): Filing follow-ups in support queue for the customers we alerted.

alice (oncall): Thanks everyone. Handing off to carla for postmortem and to ben for follow-up infra work.

carla (eng-runtime): Will post the postmortem draft in #postmortems by EOD and tag the infra/config owners.

incidents-bot: Incident mitigated — paging cleared.

alice (oncall): Closing thread soon; keeping log here for audits. End of thread.
